p: it came to pass: The Pharisees, being overcome with the truth of Christ's doctrine, propose a question about his outward calling, and are overcome by the witness of their own conscience.
Then began he to speak to: It is nothing new for those who are knowledgable of the very sanctuary of God's holy place to be the greatest enemies of Christ, but in due time they will be punished.
And they: The last refuge the false prophets have to destroy the true prophets is to charge them with rebellion and treason against the state.
watched him: An appropriate time to take him in.
spies: Whom they had hired deceitfully.
that they might take hold of: That they might latch on to something he said, and by this forge some false accusation against him.
authority of the governor: Put him to death.

person of any: You are not moved by favour of any man: and by "person" he means outward circumstances, for if a man judges according to these, there will be those who are truly alike whom he will judge to be different.
craftiness: Craftiness is a certain diligence and subtle knowledge to do evil, which is achieved by much use and great practise in matters.
Then came to him certain of: The resurrection of the flesh is affirmed against the Sadducees.

children of this world marry: "The children of this world" refers here to those who live in this world, and not those that are wholly given to the world (and therefore contrary to the children of light), as above in Lu 16:8.

children of the resurrection: That is, men who partake in the resurrection: for as we truly say that they will indeed live who will enjoy everlasting bliss, so do those indeed rise who rise to life; though if this word "resurrection" is taken generally, it refers also to the wicked, who will rise to condemnation, which is not properly life, but death.
live unto him: That is, before him: a saying to take note of, for the godly do not die, though they die here on earth.
And he said unto them: Even though Christ is the son of David according to the flesh he is also his Lord (because he is the everlasting Son of God) according to the spirit.
Beware of the scribes: We must avoid the example of the glory-seeking and covetous pastors.
houses: By the figure of speech metonymy, "houses" is understood to mean the goods and substance.
